hazards.control: Injection line rated and restrained; compressor isolated and blown down before work.

name: Compressor and injection line
function: The wellsite compressor (or the tie-in to a central system) and the metered injection line to the casing side outlet.

tabs.overview: Gas engine or electric compressor with a cooler; the injection choke and meter set the rate per well.
tabs.engineering: Discharge pressure above the deepest valve opening pressure plus line losses.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
